messages:
Maya Patel: Heads-up: syncing on the unified API surface contracts. Need final decisions on parameters, failure modes, and launch gates before PRD freeze. See draft: https://redwood.internal/specs/unified-surface-v2
Liam Chen: Quick question: what is the canonical name for the deterministic rerank opt-in? we should standardize across SDKs and console.
Anika Gomez: propose param name: `stable_rerank=true` (boolean). default false. doc SHOULD call it out as "pilot only" for first wave.
Ravi Singh: infra note: enabling stable_rerank increases KV cache retention and requires session pinning. we'll need an opt-in dedicated pool for pilots.
Jordan Brooks: SDK impact: we'll expose stable_rerank and also `client_hints.max_latency_ms`. sample request:
```json
{ "model": "redwood-rerank-1", "stable_rerank": true, "client_hints": {"max_latency_ms": 300} }
```
Maya Patel: Acceptance gates (draft):
- Contract: new params must be additive only; no breaking changes.
- Perf: hosted 95th latency targets for GA slice: chat <= 220ms, embeddings <= 160ms, rerank <= 340ms.
- Quality: rerank top-1 swap <= 2.5% (nondet), <= 1% (stable_rerank). completions top-1 A/B swap <= 1.5%. embedding cosine mean delta <= 0.02 post-quant.
- Observability: x-rw-cost-units header + x-rw-fallback reason header when applicable.
- Failover: when rerank service unavailable, API returns unranked results + header `x-rw-fallback: rerank_unavailable`.
Liam Chen: add a hard block: any quantization candidate that yields embedding cosine delta >0.025 on the pinned corpora is blocked from GA.
Anika Gomez: Edge-case behaviors to document:
- Inputs with context > 32k tokens: respond 413 + `context_too_large` and suggest chunking helper link.
- Embedding payload with NaN/Inf -> 400 with example error body.
- Empty chat content -> 422 + helpful message about structure.
Ravi Singh: operational edge cases:
- Partial stream cancellation: mark cache as reusable after 5s; emit `x-rw-stream-finalized: true` header.
- Sudden spike in rerank traffic: auto-fallback policy should switch to degraded-mode (no stable_rerank) and emit metric `rerank.fallback.triggered`.
Jordan Brooks: SDK UX: when stable_rerank=true on free-tier, SDK should surface a warning + opt-in confirmation modal in the console. Also include client-side rate limit hints.
Sasha Ortiz: Pilot customers: Atlas Analytics, Meridian Insights, EchoSearch requested deterministic rerank + per-route billing. I'll coordinate invites once product signs off.
Maya Patel: Rollout bands suggestion:
1) internal -> 2) pilots (stable_rerank allowed) -> 3) 10% public canary (nondet only) -> 4) GA (nondet by default, stable_rerank opt-in for paid customers)
Liam Chen: QA plan: create lightweight eval harness for rerank top-1/top-3 stability and embedding drift. QA to run nightly matrix across quant levels.
Anika Gomez: research will publish quantization matrix (8/4/4-bit) and expected deltas by EOD. will flag any model variants that cross thresholds.
Ravi Singh: infra tasks: allocate pilot pool, add eviction tuning for pinned sessions, add per-route cost accounting metric. I'll open tickets and link them in the PRD.
Maya Patel: owners: product=Maya, infra=Ravi, research=Anika, SDK=Jordan, QA=Liam, pilot=Sasha. I'll update PRD with these gates and owners.
Jordan Brooks: minor note: changelog entry should call out `stable_rerank` and `x-rw-cost-units` header. SDK minor bump.
Liam Chen: can we also include a fallback evaluation: when rerank unavailable return cached re-ranking if cache_age < 60s, else unranked with header. document as optional infra optimization.
Anika Gomez: agreed, add to spec as opt-in behavior per deployment type.
Maya Patel: Any blockers?
Ravi Singh: one risk: model tokenization changes for new rerank variants. need a freeze on model list by next Tue or onboarding slips.
Maya Patel: ok - freeze models Tue. research please sign off tonight.
Anika Gomez: will run final embedding stability sweep tonight and report. :thumbsup:
Maya Patel: thanks all. I'll push PRD update and a trimmed acceptance checklist. ping me if you need edits. :rocket:
